artworks.title: Sheath with Venus and Eros
artworks.description: This is a drawing of intricate and ornamental designs. The drawing features a vertical panel heavily filled with elaborate patterns and figures. In the top portion, there is a depiction of a classical scene involving mythological figures standing with a backdrop of flowing hair and drapery. Various sections throughout the drawing contain ornate motifs, including floral designs, heraldic imagery, and grotesque faces interwoven with decorative foliage. The detailed engraving style suggests a high level of craftsmanship, reminiscent of Renaissance decorative art. The drawing has an overall ornamental and intricate appearance, reflecting the complexity and richness in detail common to designs inspired by classical and mythical themes.

artworks.title: Luna
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a statuesque pose. She is standing with one arm on her hip and the other arm raised with a finger extended upward. The woman has detailed facial features with a defined nose and a serious expression. Her hair is styled back with a headpiece or band. She is wearing a flowing dress that gathers at her waist. There are architectural elements around her, including a column and an arched window framing a crescent moon in the sky. In the background, a castle with towers is visible. At her feet, there is a decorative mask-like carving. Two figures are partially visible behind her.

artworks.title: S. Philippus
artworks.description: The image shows a bearded man holding a book in his left hand and gesturing with his right hand. He has a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, and a full beard with long wavy hair. He wears a garment with a high collar and a cape-like garment over his shoulders. A long staff with a cross top is across his body. A halo is around his head. The background has horizontal lines, a leafy plant or bush, a rough-hewn wall, and Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Protector Noster Aspice ...
artworks.description: The image shows two full-length figures standing on either side of a cloth displaying the face of Christ. Both figures are positioned slightly forward and are looking downwards and sideways. They have youthful facial features, curly hair, and wings extending behind them. The angels are dressed in long, flowing robes detailed with star-like embellishments. Each angel is holding a corner of the cloth that bears the bearded face of Christ, crowned with thorns. The scene is set in a background where clouds part to reveal a radiant light at the top center. At the bottom of the image, there is an inscription that reads, "Protector noster aspice Deus, et respice in faciem Christi tui," accompanied by the artist's signature, "Hieronymus Wierx fecit et exc."

artworks.title: S. Lydtwina Virgo Schiedamensis ...
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures standing side by side. The figure on the left is dressed in robes, with long, wavy hair, a floral wreath, and a halo. They hold a crucifix. The figure on the right is an angel with wings, a halo, curly hair, and a garment with flowing sleeves. The angel holds a branch with flowers. Both figures are in an architectural setting and the image is in monochromatic color. The background includes stonework. Below the image is text in Latin script.

artworks.title: S. Andreas
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up in an etching style. He is slightly turned to one side, with his head bowed upon a book. The man has defined facial features, a prominent nose, a bearded face, and wavy hair that reaches past his ears. He wears a long robe and holds an oversized book in one hand. The background has cross-hatched lines. At the bottom, there is a textual inscription that names the figure as S. Andreas in a formal serif typeface.

artworks.title: Si mortiferum quid biberint ... (Saint John the Evangelist)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body depiction of a person who is seated and positioned slightly turned to the side. The person has long, wavy hair that falls to the shoulders and a mustache and beard framing their face. Their eyes are closed, and they hold a contemplative expression. The clothing is a loose, flowing robe with a round clasp at the collar. In one hand, the person holds a chalice with a snake coiled inside it, while the other hand is raised, with the index finger pointing upwards. Behind the person, there is an eagle. Both the individual and the eagle are set against a backdrop featuring radiating lines. The image is in a monochromatic color scheme, consistent with etched drawings. At the bottom of the image, there is a Latin inscription.

artworks.title: S. P. Benedictus
artworks.description: The image shows an upper body depiction of a person in a prayerful position, with hands together and looking upwards. The person has short, neat hair and a solemn facial expression, dressed in a long robe with a hood, holding a crozier in the left hand. They are surrounded by a radiant halo. The background features finely engraved details with beams of light radiating from a figure in the upper right corner, surrounded by two angels. Additionally, there are inscribed texts visible at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Fasciculus myrrhae dilectus meus mihi
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals from the waist up. One person, on the left, is seated and cradling the other person in their arms. The person on the left is wearing a veil over their head, obscuring much of their hair, with closed eyes facing slightly downward. They are enveloped in a heavy cloak or robe. The person on their lap has closed eyes, facial hair, including a beard, and slightly curly, shoulder-length hair. Their upper body is partially exposed, showing the chest and arms, with a wound on the hand. Both individuals have halos above their heads. The background consists of artistic line work enhancing the figures in the foreground.

artworks.title: O quam tristis et afflicta ...
artworks.description: The image features two figures. One person is positioned on the left, resting with eyes closed and head tilted back, supported by the other figure on the right. The first person has shoulder-length hair, a beard, and a mustache, with a draping cloth covering his bare chest. The second person, wearing a headscarf or hood, looks slightly upward with a gentle expression. Both figures have circular halos above their heads. The woman holds the man's body with both hands, and a decorative script is present at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: Frustra pater nauem dabit
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures around a boat in a pastoral setting. The scene depicts several figures engaged in activity centered around a large wooden barrel or boat. One figure is hammering or working on the top of the boat, surrounded by four other figures who appear to be assisting or participating in the activity. Behind the group is a house with a thatched roof, set amidst a rural landscape with a bare tree and another tree with leaves in the foreground. The scene exudes a sense of industriousness and craftsmanship in a serene, pastoral environment. Below the scene, there is a piece of text in Latin.

artworks.title: Dum pierulo fugendum ...
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals, a woman with a child on her lap, and a man standing next to them. The woman has styled hair partly covered, while the child has curly hair and looks outward. The man has a beard and is gazing gently. Both individuals have halos above their heads. The woman wears a long gown with flowing sleeves, the man wears a long robe with a hood, and the child is wrapped in a simple garment. The woman holds a cluster of grapes. The background is a detailed vineyard with vines, grapes, flying birds, and small animals in the foreground.

artworks.title: Ecce tu pulcher es Dilecte ...
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures, a woman seated with a child sleeping on her lap. The woman has her hands clasped in prayer, looking down at the child. She wears a crown on her head, a veil covering her hair, and layered garments with intricate patterns. The child is wrapped in a floral blanket, resting against a cushion. A halo surrounds the woman's head, and there are radiant lines in the background. The image contains an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Baptismo habeo baptisari ...
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling with their eyes closed and arms crossed over their chest. The individual has delicate facial features with short, curly hair and wears a long robe. Various objects are scattered around, including a cross marked "INRI," ropes, a pitcher, a plate, and a crown of thorns. In the background, there is a textured design and a scroll with an inscription. The foreground contains tools and symbols related to penance and crucifixion.

artworks.title: S. Laurentius Martyr
artworks.description: The image depicts a man shown from the waist up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left, looking upwards with a serene expression on his face. His facial features include a prominent forehead, curved eyebrows, and a pronounced nose, with short, curly hair. He is wearing detailed, ornate clothing that resembles ecclesiastical robes, adorned with decorative patterns, particularly around the shoulder and neck area. The man holds a gridiron, a grid-like structure, with one arm wrapped around it, and he carries a palm frond in his hand. He is depicted with a halo. The background features a linear pattern.

artworks.title: Tuam ipsius animam ...
artworks.description: The image shows a person with a serene expression, hands clasped in front. The person wears a cloak with a hood, holding a sword in the left hand that extends diagonally upwards. There are rays emanating from the person, creating a halo effect, and a Latin inscription at the bottom of the image.

artworks.title: S. Maria Magdalena
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up. She is turned to the side, with her head tilted forward and downward. Her facial features include closed eyes, arched eyebrows, and a serene expression. Her hair is gathered up at the back and some pieces frame her face. She wears flowing clothes with intricate details, and holds a book in her left hand and an ornate jar in her right hand. The background shows a landscape with crosses, trees, and a city or castle structure.

artworks.title: S. Virgo Virginum
artworks.description: The image features a woman facing forward with her head slightly tilted upwards. She has a serene expression, large eyes, and delicate lips. Her hair is partially covered by a veil, and she is wearing a robe with a cloak draped over her shoulders. Her hands are crossed over her chest. A halo of star-like shapes surrounds her head, and three other veiled figures are beside her, holding palm branches. The background has a textured, radiating pattern with no discernible setting.

artworks.title: Leda
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with figures and animals in a circular medallion. The scene features a reclining figure alongside a large swan, enclosed within swirling foliage and decorative elements like scrolls and animal figures. Above, there is an ornate canopy topped with a cherubic face or mask. The drawing showcases intricate ornamentation typical of Renaissance or Baroque decorative styles.

artworks.title: Diana
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene with elaborate decorations. There is a central figure, possibly a deity, with a hunting dog, holding a crescent object and a spear. This figure is surrounded by an arching structure with floral patterns. On either side stand two symmetrical nude figures holding bows, with decorative shields nearby. Above them are stylized ram figures emerging from acanthus leaves. Above the central figure is a cherubic face surrounded by scrolls and foliage motifs. At the bottom are two smaller, semi-nude figures reaching upwards amidst swirling waves and ornate scrollwork. The composition is detailed and embellished with symmetrical ornamental designs including flora, twisted ropes, and abstract shapes.

artworks.title: Standing Soldier in a Long Cloak
artworks.artist: Teodoro Filippo di Liagno, called Napoletano
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The individual's face is visible beneath the shadow of a hood, showing defined facial features with short, somewhat unkempt hair. They wear a heavy cloak with a hood over layered garments, fastened at the front. The attire includes long, vertically striped pants or a skirt, tucked into boots that extend above the ankle. The person holds a cylindrical object, possibly a staff or a tool, in their left hand. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the subject in the foreground.

artworks.title: Head of a Cleric
artworks.description: This image is a detailed drawing showing the profile of a man's upper body - specifically his head and shoulders. The man is positioned in a side profile, facing to the right. His facial features are distinctive, with a prominent chin and lips, a bulbous nose, and a well-defined jawline. He has short, curly hair, which is partially covered by a woven cap decorated with a pattern. His clothing includes a coat with a fur collar, and there is a cord near his neck with a decorative element or button. The background of the image has a textured pattern created by crosshatching. There is an inscription at the bottom left which reads "Bossi Sc. f. 1778."

artworks.title: Christ Arrives on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people walking together along a path in a natural setting. A figure with a shining outline around their head leads the group, with long hair and a beard. The other figures are also dressed in robes and cloaks. The background features dense foliage, an arched fence or wall, distant buildings, and a cloudy sky.

artworks.title: Christ Praying on the Mount of Olives
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a figure kneeling before an angel on a cloud. The artwork depicts a cloaked figure kneeling in a gesture of reverence or prayer. Above, on a cloud, an angelic being is depicted with wings, raising one hand as if gesturing towards the sky, and holding a chalice in the other hand. The background is filled with detailed foliage and trees. The scene is illuminated by beams of light from the heavens, highlighting the spiritual connection between the earthly figure and the angel. The line work and shading enhance the drawing's depth and form, emphasizing its mystical and contemplative theme.
